name: Darkness
description:
Concentration, up to 10 minutes.

Choose a point or object within short range. Magical darkness emanates out from it to short range. If you chose an object, the darkness moves with the object.

Mundane light and natural vision do not pierce the darkness. Only light or sight granted by a spell with a greater XP cost that this one can penetrate the darkness.

Release (Fear):

  • +Range to the darkness' radius.

  • The darkness is also deathly cold. Creatures that enter or begin their turn in the darkness take 1d4 damage.

  • You can see through the darkness as if it weren't there.
